2014_spells.lesser-restoration.descripti: You touch a creature and can end either one disease or one condition afflicting it. The condition can be blinded, deafened, paralyzed, or poisoned.
2014_spells.lesser-restoration.effectSum: Make a target blinded until it saves or the spell ends
2014_spells.lesser-restoration.fullDescr: Using 1 action, you touch a creature and can end either one disease or one condition afflicting it. The condition can be blinded, deafened, paralyzed, or poisoned. The effect happens immediately and then ends.
